facts.anchor: Wacker stopped KRAY in the hallway.

facts.fact: KRAY 加入十五人的简报团队。
facts.anchor: He joined the briefing team, fifteen strong, as it was headed out.

facts.fact: 简报地点在 MUCHADOO 的 Executive Conference Room，是 KRAY 第一次上七楼。
facts.anchor: The briefing was set for the Executive Conference Room in DC/HR/DNCS MUCHADOO’s office suite.

facts.fact: KLIMT 预计本财年第四季度按时按预算完成数字指标。
facts.anchor: We project bein’ able to meet our numerical numbers on time and under budget by the fourth quarter a the fiscal year.

facts.fact: 一位叫 Cooper 的幕僚来自纽约市。
facts.anchor: My name’s Cooper. I’m from New York City.

facts.fact: Cooper 低声约 KRAY 到走廊左边男厕所见面。
facts.anchor: As Cooper brushed past KRAY on his way out the door, he whispered, “Meet me in the Men’s Room out in the hallway on the left.”

facts.fact: KRAY 说 GOOWIKI 下还没有任何人被部署。
facts.anchor: No one has been deployed yet under GOOWIKI.

facts.fact: Cooper 的名片上印着 DEAN BRETT COOPER。
facts.anchor: Printed on it in capital letters was the name DEAN BRETT COOPER.
